name: Midnight — Quel’Thalas and the Dawnwell
cartographyLabel: MIDNIGHT RELEASED CHAPTER — APPROXIMATE QUEL’THALAS FOCUS
interpretationNote: Approximate atlas anchors distinguish Eversong, the Sunwell/Dawnwell site, and the Coiled Isle. They are not battle fronts, control areas, or exact surveys. Darkwell and Dawnwell are sequential states of the Sunwell.
